Normal water is hypotonic or isotonic to your cells , meaning that there is a higher concentration of water outside your cells than in them . This causes water to flow into your cells due to the pressure of the water outside being greater than the pressure of the water inside . This is called osmosis , and it is how your body gets hydrated . Saltwater is hypertonic to your cells , which is the opposite of hypotonic . This causes water to flow out of your cells because the dissolved minerals and particulates in the water lowers the concentration of the saltwater outside your cells , making it less than the concentration of water inside your cells . This loss of water is called reverse osmosis , and this is how your cells become dehydrated . You can see this in action by cutting a carrot in half and salting the cut surface . After a few minutes , the cut surface will be wet , as the salt has drawn water out of the carrot 's cells . Alternatively , pure water ( not purified , as that still has dissolved minerals in it , but 100 % H2O ) is VERY hypotonic to your cells , causing more water to flow into the cells and inflating the cell to larger proportions than the cell membrane can handle , which makes your cells burst . Pure water will cause stomach ulcers if drank frequently enough .

Sound is the result of vibrations . Everything we touch is surrounded by air . Take your cat for instance . He is surrounded by air . If he wants to move , he has to push the air out of the way to make room for himself . So if the cat swishes his tail once , his tail will push air out of the way to make room . The air will also rush to take the place where his tail used to be . Now instead of all of the air in the room immediately rearranging to make room for the cat 's new position , the air closest to the cat 's tail is going to get squeezed together like a spring while most of the air stays still . But then the compressed air needs to spread out again , so it 's going to push more air out of the way in order to expand . Now the air near the cat 's tail is spread out again , but we have more compressed air further away that also needs to expand and it 's going to push more air out of the way . This is called a compression wave and it will keep moving around the room until all of the air in the room is spread out as evenly as possible . Now imagine the cat is really wagging its tail . This is a form of vibration . The cat 's tail is going to create a compression wave each time it moves . If it is wagging fast enough , you might have multiple compression waves in the air at the same time . If his tail is wagging REALLY fast , the compression waves get really close together , and if he is wagging more slowly , the compression waves get further apart . The speed of the wagging - the speed of vibration - is called " frequency " and the distance between compression waves is called " wavelength " . When those compression waves from the tail reach our ear drums , it vibrates our ear drums at the same frequency as the cat 's tail . That vibration is channeled from our ear drums into our inner ear where nerve cells interpret the vibrations as " electrical " signals to our brain . If the cat 's tail was vibrating fast enough and pushing enough air around , our brain would receive the signal from the vibrations and interpret the signal as sound . When the frequency is high , we hear high pitch noises from things like flutes or tweeters , and when the frequency is low , we hear low pitch noises from objects like bass drums and subwoofers . A microphone works in a similar way to our ears and brain - the compression waves from the cat 's tail move a diaphragm ( a slim layer of material similar to our ear drums ) and the diaphragm vibrates at the same speed as our cat 's tail . The diaphragm is connected to a coiled wire , so when the diaphragm moves , the coil moves with it . When you move the coil over a magnet , it creates electricity , which we use as an electrical signal to represent the sound . A speaker works like a microphone in reverse - there 's a diaphragm and a magnet and a coil . But in this case , we send the electrical signal back to the coil where it creates a magnetic field and pushes or pulls against the magnet . Since the coil is pushing and pulling it starts moving and since the diaphragm is attached , the diaphragm moves with it . So now the diaphragm is moving at the same speed as the original sound from the cat 's tail , creating compression waves that are VERY similar to the original compression waves from the cat 's tail . The reason small headphones ca n't produce lots of strong bass is because of the size of the speakers . Every time the speaker moves , it moves a certain amount of air . The amount of air a speaker can move is determined by the diameter of the speaker and the distance it can travel ( excursion ) . As a sound gets lower in frequency , we have to move more air to hear it at the same volume . So high frequencies can be played by speakers with small diameters and tiny excursions ( 1 inch tweeter with half a millimeter excursion ) , whereas low frequencies need to be played by large speakers with large excursions ( 8 inch woofer with half inch excursion ) .

There 's actually several reasons why financial institutions ( such as banks , pension funds , and the like ) buy bonds that yield negative interest . The first reason is fairly straightforward : the assets that financial instutions can or need to hold have become increasingly regulated , especially in light of the recent financial crises . Some regulators have imposed requirements on banks to maintain a certain portion of safe and liquid assets ( meaning they can easily be sold off for cash ) . The aim of such regulatory intervention is to ensure that those financial institutions are able to get quick access to cash in case of a crisis . The downside , however , is that this increases demand for " safe " assets immensely , to the point where all that may be left for some institutions to buy is bonds with negative yields . In short , the institutions are then forced by those regulatory requirements to buy those negative - yield assets . A second , equally important reason , might seem paradoxical at first : financial institutions may hope to actually earn money on those bonds despite their negative yields . One way negative - yield bonds can turn out to be profitable is simply when the financial institution can sell it for a higher price than the one at which it bought the bond ( e.g. if it paid 100 USD for a bond and can sell it for 105 USD ) . Such increases in value can , for instance , occur when the bond is valued in a different currency . If , for example , a US bank buys German bonds , it can make a profit by selling those bonds after the euro becomes more valuable ( e.g. a bank buying a bond denominated in euro at 100 euro makes a profit when the euro " appreciates " ( i.e. becomes more valuable ) . Rather than being worth 100 USD ( if the original exchange rate was 1 USD to 1 euro ) , the bond would then be worth for instance 105 USD ( if the new exchange rate is 1 USD to 1.05 euro ) . A more subtle way to make a " profit " on a negative - yield bond is when the bond is simply the least bad option . A lot of central banks charge a negative interest to banks for depositing their money with them . If the negative yield on the bond is lower than the negative interest charged by the central bank , it is preferable to buy the bond . After all , while the bank will still lose money , it will lose less money than if it went for the alternative , i.e. taking the central bank 's negative interest . The same goes when there is " deflation " , i.e. when money becomes less valuable over time . If your money loses value , it would be preferable to invest in a bond whose negative yield is lower than the money you would lose just keeping the cash .

A wart is a small , rough growth resembling a cauliflower or a solid blister . It typically occurs on humans ' hands or feet but often in other locations . Warts occur when the virus comes in contact with your skin and causes an infection . Warts are more likely to develop on broken skin , such as picked hangnails or areas nicked by shaving , because the virus is able to enter the top layer of skin through scratches or cuts . Most warts are harmless and clear up without treatment . The length of time it takes a wart to disappear will vary from person to person . It may take up to two years for the viral infection to leave your system and for the wart to disappear . Common methods of treatment include : salicylic acid cryotherapy ( freezing the skin cells ) duct tape chemical treatments Treatment for warts is not always completely effective , and a wart will sometimes return following treatment . Surgery is not usually recommended for warts .

In short , when you have a reversible reaction , you can force the reaction to go in one direction or the other by fiddling with the conditions under which the reaction is taking place . Reversible reactions can go either way and typically slow to a halt before finishing completely . For example , if you mix nitrogen and hydrogen together to make ammonia , only some of the nitrogen and hydrogen will react , and the progress of the reaction will level off at some point and stop . This is because while there are still nitrogen and hydrogen molecules reacting with each other , there are just as many ammonia molecules that are decomposing back into the constituent gases . But if you squeeze the reaction vessel you will force more nitrogen and hydrogen molecules to react , and you will get more ammonia out of it . This is because it takes one nitrogen molecule and three hydrogen molecules - four total - to make just two molecules of ammonia . When you squeeze the reaction vessel , you are forcing the gases to readjust themselves to take up less volume , and since two molecules of the product gas take up less volume than four molecules of the reactant gases , squeezing it will force the reaction to produce more ammonia . Release the pressure and the ammonia will decompose back into nitrogen and hydrogen again . You can also fiddle with temperature . The reaction of nitrogen and hydrogen to make ammonia gives off a certain amount of heat ; if you chill the reaction vessel , you draw off heat and encourage the production of more ammonia ; warm it up , and the ammonia will decompose back into nitrogen and hydrogen . So in general , the principle may be stated thus : a system in equilibrium will shift the equilibrium in response to stress placed on it .

The theory is that the money that wealthy individuals spend and invest " trickles down " to those that are less wealthy . Here 's an example : taxes are decreased slightly for wealthy individuals , resulting in them having more money . These people then invest the money in new companies and technologies ( through buying stocks , etc . ) therefore resulting in new innovation and jobs . These people might also spend the money on a more expensive car than they would otherwise been able to afford , resulting in innovation Example : if someone buys a top of the line BMW , then money is being invested in cars that can do high - tech things like auto parking , new safety technologies like airbags that shield the driver 's legs , and things like having sensors around the vehicle . Because money is being invested in these new car technologies , the technologies will get better and less expensive , resulting in a " trickle down " to less expensive models of car . There has been a strong debate as to whether trickle down economics actually does as the theory suggests and how much wealth actually trickles down .

This is how bleach essentially strips away color . However , different materials , colors , and amounts of bleach can affect the oxidation process enough to produce a range of shades from white to yellow .

A deductible is the amount you have to pay before your insurance pays anything . I 'll give you some examples : ----------------------- 1 . Imagine you own a car . You have insurance to protect yourself from someone hitting you with their car . You have a $ 5,000 deductible . Someone hits your car . They cause $ 4,000 worth of damage . Because your deductible is $ 5,000 - and $ 4,000 is less than $ 5,000 - you pay the entire cost to fix your car and your insurance pays $ 0 . However , let 's say someone hits your car and causes $ 15,000 worth of damage . You pay the " first " $ 5,000 - this is your deductible - and the insurance pays the " second " $ 10,000 . ----------------------------------- 2 . Say you have insurance to cover the cost of prescriptions . Your annual deductible is $ 2,000 . So you go to the doctor and he tells you that you need to buy some medicine . The cost for the medicine is $ 500 . Because $ 500 is less than $ 2,000 you pay the entire $ 500 and your insurance pays $ 0 . But imagine if he tells you that the medicine costs $ 10,000 . Then you pay the " first " $ 2,000 and your insurance pays the " second " $ 8,000 . ------------------------------------- The idea behind the deductible is twofold : 1 ) insurance companies , like all companies , exist to make a profit and that means paying as little as possible , and 2 ) if you have to spend your own money then you 're less likely to waste it than if you feel like you 're spending " free " money .

Are you Rhesus positive ? Rhesus status only matters if you have a RhD - negative mother who is carrying an RhD - positive baby . Your child will have inherited this from your RhD - positive blood . If some of the baby 's blood enters your gf 's bloodstream , their immune system may react to the D antigen in your baby 's blood . It will be treated as a foreign invader and your body will produce antibodies against it . This is known as a sensitising event . Sensitising is not usually harmful if it is your first pregnancy . But it can cause problems if you become pregnant again with another RhD - positive baby . The antibodies that your body made in your first pregnancy can cross the placenta and attack the blood cells of your baby . When your baby 's blood cells are attacked , it can cause anaemia . If the anaemia becomes severe , it can lead to life - threatening problems for your baby , such as heart failure and fluid retention . A simple blood test can detect the issue , and if it is the case doctors can manage it if it is her first pregnancy .

Every device on the internet has an IP address . This address must be unique , there can be no two devices with the same IP . The number of IP addresses is limited , and mostly used up . There is a group of addresses that have been reserved for use only in internal networks . This works because the devices sharing an address can not see each other - they are on different networks with no route between them . Nat is implemented by a device ( a computer , a router , or a firewall ) that has two network connections , one to the internal network , one to the internet . When a device on the internal network wants to connect outside , it sends its messages ( packets ) to the NAT device . The NAT device strips the address of the original device and substitutes its own , then sends it out to the internet . When the reply comes back , the NAT device then strips its own address , substitutes the address of the original device , and sends it to the internal network . In this way , many devices can share one IP address .

The material used to make the lens can be anything , but is usually either air or an explosive with a different shockwave velocity .

The main idea of " The Big Short " is that a small group of people saw that houses were overvalued . Banks and investors had been paying a lot of money to buy and build up houses all over the United States up till 2008 , with the expectation that these houses were going to go up in value . Because houses had been steadily increasing in value for so long , everyone got the crazy idea that houses never go down in value . So everyone kept investing more and more and more money into houses , creating what is known as " a bubble . " " Bubbles " like this have existed throughout the history of economics . The oldest recorded [ economic bubble ] ( URL_0 ) actually revolved around [ tulips ] ( URL_1 ) , of all things . Bubbles always pop , causing people who get out early to make a lot of money , and people who get out late to lose a lot of money . The housing bubble was unique for two reasons . The first was that the housing market was supposed to be well regulated , to prevent it from becoming so overvalued . Much of " The Big Short " explores the many ways in which this regulation became corrupt and malfunctioning . The other thing that made the housing bubble unique was how broad the effects of the collapse were . So many things were tied to the housing market , because it was considered so dependable , so when that market crashed , it had huge , far reaching effects . Because of this , the government had to bail the financial sector out to , to prevent the US economy from collapsing . But this had the unfortunate effect of sparing the financial sector from punishment for their misbehavior .

I use a Raspberry Pi as file server inside my house that 's connected to a big USB hard drive . It runs a program called [ Sick Beard ] ( URL_2 ) that knows what TV shows I like , when they come out , and how to go on the internet and look for them . When a TV show comes out on TV , it finds information on how to download it , which it then passes to another program called [ NZBGet ] ( URL_1 ) . NZBGet downloads the shows and then tells Sick Beard that they 're done , so that Sick Beard can put it in the right place on the hard drive . It then talks to another program called [ XBMC ] ( URL_0 ) , which is running on a different computer that is connected to my TV . XBMC looks kind of like what you see when you 're using the set top boxes that come with a satellite dish or a cable service , but it 's mostly for playing movies and TV shows and stuff that 's on your computer or on a network , and it also does a lot more . Anyway , Sick Beard tells XBMC that new shows have arrived . XBMC is able to connect to the Raspberry Pi using a method called FTP , and it also knows where TV shows are stored . So , rather than buying a PVR device to record TV shows for me off of my satellite , which can be pretty unreliable , I instead let my Raspberry Pi worry about downloading them automatically . And what 's more , I can watch those TV shows from any computer or phone or tablet in my house . It 's done a much better job of it for me , in my opinion .

Your face , like every human 's , is assymetrical , meaning that it is not perfectly the same on either side .. Maybe one of your eyes is slightly higher than the other . Maybe your nose points slightly to one side . While a photo shows these differences as they would look like to another person looking at you , a mirror shows the reverse of what everyone else sees . Imagine that your reflection in the mirror is an actual person standing across from you . If your right eye is higher than your left eye , the person standing across from you in the mirror will have their left eye higher than their right eye . If your nose points a little to the right , the person in the mirror 's nose points to their left . Your right hand is the person in the mirror 's left hand . If this is hard to understand , it may help to imagine yourself looking at the person in the mirror and then turning around and standing side by side with that person . If you look straight at yourself standing next to your reflection , you will see that you do not completely match up . The reason you notice the difference between what you look like in the mirror and what you look like in a photo is that you see yourself in the mirror more often than in photos and you are more used to your mirror image . You probably look in the mirror every morning and night , but you probably only see pictures of yourself once in awhile . Because you most often see your mirror image instead of your actual image , you probably like your mirror image better . It is called the Mere - Exposure Effect . In the same way you like a song you 've heard before more than a song you 've never heard before , you like your mirror image more because you see it more . The more you see ( or hear , taste , smell , or touch ) something , the more you like it . I hope this answers your question . Please let me know if it does not . Tl;dr : Your mirror image is the reverse or opposite of what you look like to other people or in photos . You like your mirror image more because you are more used to seeing it than photos .

They 're different chemicals . An alcohol is a string of carbon atoms that are bonded to hydrogen atoms everywhere except that there 's an ( OH ) in place of a hydrogen atom somewhere . Methanol is the simplest alcohol , consisting of just one carbon atom , 3 hydrogen atoms , and one ( OH ) group . Ethanol is basically the same as methanol , except it has two carbon atoms . Isopropyl alcohol has three carbons , but it 's a little different from methanol and ethanol . Instead of having the ( OH ) group at one end of the molecule , it has it sticking out of the middle . In terms of effects on the human body , they all do similar things . The problem with drinking methanol and isopropanol is that the stuff your body metabolizes them into is quite toxic and can cause a lot of bad stuff to happen . Fortunately , one way to treat overdoses of methanol and isopropanol by getting the person very drunk for a while . Your body prefers to metabolize ethanol over methanol and isopropanol , so staying drunk for a while allows you to get rid of the methanol or isopropanol by breathing , sweating , and urinating it out directly without being turned into bad stuff .

There are different types of injections . intramuscular . intravenous . Subcutaneous . A subcutaneous injection is a method of administering medication . Subcutaneous means under the skin . In this type of injection , a short needle is used to inject a drug into the tissue layer between the skin and the muscle . Medication given this way is usually absorbed more slowly than if injected into a vein , sometimes over a period of 24 hours . An intramuscular injection is a technique used to deliver a medication deep into the muscles . This allows the medication to be absorbed into the bloodstream quickly . You may have received an intramuscular injection at a doctor ’s office the last time you got a vaccine , like the flu shot . In some cases , a person may also self - administer an intramuscular injection . For example , certain drugs that treat multiple sclerosis or rheumatoid arthritis may require self - injection .

In the case of Taiwan , China 's ( People 's Republic of China / PRC ) official policy is essentially " one country , two systems . " Under this policy , Taiwan ( as well as Hong Kong and Macau ) are technically considered territories of the PRC , but are allowed to operate with a high level of autonomy , maintaining their own political and economic systems . So China does not actively try to interfere with Taiwan 's governance , but does maintain that it is a territory of China and not a separate nation . One factor that no one has mentioned yet is that a significant proportion of homeless people have psychological disorders , namely schizophrenia . Males are more likely to develop schizophrenia , and the age of incidence in males is younger than in females . While males tend to show schizophrenic symptoms in their teens to 20 's , females tend to show psychotic symptoms in their 30 's . Taking these two things into consideration , it is reasonable that someone in their 30 's has had more time to build a support system , to have established themselves in society , and to have people and resources to fall back on once they begin to be less functional . An 18 - year - old is less likely to have these things , so they would be more likely to end up on the streets due to lack of resources for therapy . There are definitely other factors that contribute to the disproportionality of homeless males and females , but the prevalence of mental disorders should not be overlooked .

Finding the volume of solids with sides that can be represented by an equation , like if you have a lathe that can move its cutting bit in and out based on an equation like y = x^2 , you can use calculus to find the volume of the piece of metal you machined with the lathe . You can also find the rate at which a container will fill up if it is both gaining and losing liquid , even if those rates of liquid being added and removed change over time . You can combine the two and find how high the water level would be in a container with radius = height^2 after some time of being filled at a certain rate . Flow of current in electrical circuits is similar to flow of liquids , and can also be calculated with calculus . You can also calculate the force of water exerted on a dam holding water back . The force exerted on each part of the dam changes with the depth of the water , and you can use calculus to sum up all of those forces from depth=0 up to the top of the water level . There are also applications in computer graphics , although there 's probably more trigonometry and algebra than calculus . If you want to draw a curve on the screen , calculus can help you find equations with endpoints and slopes that will match up with each other . Calculus overall in the simplest terms is a set of tools used to work on sums , series , and rates of change . Sums like using the disc method to find the volume of the aforementioned solids machined by a lathe . Series like trying to determine if the sum of N!/2^N from N=0 up to N=∞ is infinite or finite ( closely related to rates of change , i.e. which one grows faster as N approaches infinity , 2^N or N ! , is there a limit , does it approach some value ? ) Rates of change are used in sums , like what is the total change in volume of water when two different rates of change are pouring into one container .

Life as we know it needs water , so when looking for life , it is logical to start by looking for water . Life may well exist in many strange forms , but we have to assume that we are a common sort of life , and not an aberration . To apply an analogy , if you 're looking for your lost keys , you look in the places that you normally keep them . Sure , they may be in the rain gutter , but it makes sense to look in the places that you 've found them before . Water has the following properties , among many others , that makes it very useful for living things : 1 ) Water has an incredibly high heat capacity . This means that it is very good keeping things at a relatively constant temperature . The fact that we contain lots of water means that it takes a lot of energy to change our temperature . Ammonia is one of the few chemicals with a higher heat capacity than water , which is one reason that some have considered it as a substitute for water . 2 ) Water has a wide range of temperatures in which it is a liquid . A ocean of water can provide the movement needed for complex systems to quickly evolve . The liquid phase makes it easy for things to move around and interact , but still maintains its volume , unlike gases . Most theories that involve chemicals other than water still call for some liquid in the process . 3 ) Water is also uncommon in that when it freezes , the water ice is less dense than the liquid and it floats to the top . The ice on the top of the liquid provides insulation for the water below , so that even in the coldest of weather , a lake rarely freezes all the way through . 4 ) Its chemical structure makes it incredibly useful in chemical reactions . Water is able to act assist in chemical reactions like no other known chemical . 5 ) Water is common and stable . Our planet has it . Our moon has it . Comets have it . Mars has it . Now we have discovered several other moons that have it .

The sound on a record is - at the simplest level - produced by the needle bouncing over a series of peaks and valleys in the groove . The peaks and valleys toward the center of the record are closer together along the track of the groove than the ones at the edge . Think of a dish with two sets of dashes running around the edge of the plate . One is right at the edge , the other halfway toward the middle . Both have eight dashes total , so the one halfway toward the middle has to have either shorter dashes or smaller spaces between dashes . As a result of the increased space between the peaks and valleys , the grooves toward the edge end up being able to produce better - quality sound than the ones toward the center . This is part of the reason why the best songs on a record are typically at the beginning of each side .

Combustion engines work by exploding gasoline in tiny amounts . These tiny explosions make expanding gas , which produces a pressure . This is what drives your engine . This pressure makes your engine parts rotate and spin . With gears and mechanical parts , your engine 's spinning parts transfer the rotation into the wheels . By pressing the pedal , you increase the amount of explosions happening , which increases the amount of spinning going on in the engine , which increases the speed your wheels spin at . By using your transmission , you can change the gears and mechanical parts to make your wheels spin faster or slower , with less or more power .

Constitutionally , the Monarch serves as both Head of State and Head of the Nation of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland . As Head of State , The Queen undertakes constitutional and representational duties which have developed over one thousand years of history . Primarily , these are embodied in the Royal Prerogative : a body of customary authority , privilege , and immunity left in the hands of the crown . It is the Queen that sends and receives ambassadors , issues passports , appoints the Prime Minister , signs Acts into law , etc . The Queen remains constitutionally empowered to exercise the Royal Prerogative against the advice of the prime minister or the cabinet , but in practice the last time this happened was 1708 . Head of Nation is a less formal , social and cultural function that is none the less an important part of the British way of life . The role includes providing a focus for national identity , unity and pride ; giving a sense of stability and continuity ; recognising success , achievement and excellence ; and supporting service to others , particularly through public service and the voluntary sector . The Queen also has an essential role in providing a sense of stability and continuity in times of political and social change . While political parties change constantly , the Sovereign continues as Head of State , providing a stable framework within which a government can introduce wide - ranging reforms .

The producer is the one who gets things started on the movie . Generally , it is their idea in the first place to make the movie . They provide the financial backing for it or find the finances through an outside source , such as a production studio or investors . The major crew members are often selected by the producer , and if the movie uses big stars , they may be chosen by the producer as well . Producers generally have little involvement in the actual filming of the movie , but they have the final say in any decision about it . Directors are the driving force behind the actual filming . They make the major artistic decisions about casting , sets , locations , costumes , cinemetography , script changes , and so on , although they are generally helped in these areas by assitant directors and other crew members . During filming , they direct the staging and acting of the actors themselves . The director is usually the person in charge while on set . The writer is the person who actually writes the script for the movie . After writing it , they pitch it to production studios or individual producers in order to get it made into a movie . They are usually not involved at all in the actual filming except maybe as a creative consultant . Note that the same person can fill more than one of these roles . A producer might choose to direct a movie himself , or a writer may find a way to produce her own script .

Trees , like any other plant , reproduce by spreading their seeds . Many trees improve their odds by packing their seeds with nutrients and protection in order to give them the best possible start wherever they land . In addition , many trees make use of birds and other animals to spread their seed . Nuts and fruits make nutritious treats to lure animals into eating them . When the seed passes through their digestive tracts unharmed , it finally lands on the ground away from the parent tree in a nice pile of nutritious crap . In extreme environments where nutrition is very scare , plants sometimes only bloom once every so many years when it has build up sufficient reserves for the plant to bloom without exhausting it 's reserves . Alternatively , some plants bloom extravagantly when the plant is damaged in order to spread it 's seed before the plant dies .

In the wild , you 're vulnerable when you 're asleep . So there is an instinct to be aware of the environment you choose to sleep in , and to be irritated by things that might intuitively make the place more dangerous . For instance , most people would not choose to put a bed in the very middle of a large , wide - open room where every direction is open , especially when sleeping alone . People find it comforting to have walls on one or more sides , limiting directions of approach . Even with no rational reason to find a big , open space unsuitable for sleeping , most people would avoid it or take time to get used to it . This is also why bedrooms tend to not be very big even in large houses , and why even people with large studio apartments may create their own visual barriers around their bed . A huge , echoing chasm of a space in the darkness is not the greatest recipe for comfortable sleep .
